defect_observations.observation: Annex designators disagree in print. The forward reference added for GOAL-03 (handbook/restoration/inherited-01946-02186.tex:345-348) uses \ref, which prints the annexitem counter: 'Annex P2.49' and 'Annex P2.50' (w02b build tmp/builds/w02b/handbook/main.pdf, physical page 2611). The annexitem heading prints the uppercased id instead: 'Annex P2.PROP.TSEITIN' and 'Annex P2.PROP.TSEITIN-SIZE' (physical pages 9591 and 9594). The theorem status taglines print the same id form. 'P2.49' and 'P2.50' appear nowhere in the annex, only in cross-references on physical pages 2536, 2611 and 2700. In the PDF the hyperlinks resolve to the right items (annexitem.annex.2.annexitem.49 and .50), so this does not change the GOAL-03 verdict. A reader of a printed copy, however, cannot match the cited number to a heading. The cause is the book-wide macro: it labels \theannexitem but displays \hb@curannexid.
